title: Cohort activation alignment and OKR resourcing for private deployments (Q2)
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: We need a clear, resourced plan to activate customer cohorts for Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments across Q2 that maps to OKRs, ensures engineering capacity, and reduces churn risk for early enterprise adopters. This ticket captures alignment between product, engineering, solutions, and sales on activation waves, success metrics, and the resource plan required to meet SLAs and onboarding targets.

Scope: - Define 3 activation waves (pilot -> scale -> steady state) with timeboxes and acceptance gates. - Translate OKRs (security, reliability, onboarding throughput) into concrete milestones and staffing needs. - Produce a resourcing playbook for on-call/SE support, rollout engineers, and integration QA. - Capture rollback and fallback policies tied to release windows.

Out of scope: detailed engineering tasks (tracked in ENG deps), individual customer onboarding playbooks (handled by Solutions).
updates: 2026-02-25: Kickoff sync with Eng, Solutions, Sales. Agreed on initial wave definitions: Pilot (5 customers), Wave A (20 customers), Wave B (remaining cohort).

2026-03-02: Eng capacity review (ENG-98021) flagged need for 0.6 FTE of runtime reliability work during Wave A; trade-off: delay some non-blocking runtime improvements to prioritize activation stability.
2026-03-08: Security team requested an enclave+KMS checklist for pilots. Added security_review_required=true and assigned remediation tasks to ENG-101122.

2026-03-12: Product & Solutions agreed on metrics: time-to-first-response <= 4 hours, onboarding success rate >= 95% for Pilot, mean latency SLAs validated on dedicated infra. Documented in linked Confluence page.

2026-03-14: Rollout runbook draft reviewed by Head of Customer Success; recommended adding a hot-fix path and a rollback checklist for tenant state migration — action: incorporate before Wave A kickoff.
2026-03-15: Updated resourcing table; confirmed Sales will prioritize 8 pilot customers with completed security questionnaires. Next: finalize SE roster and on-call rotation.
acceptance_criteria: Activation waves and dates published to stakeholders and calendar (Pilot start no later than 2026-04-01).
Resourcing plan signed off, including SE roster, dedicated rollout engineers, and 24/7 incident rotation for Wave A.
OKR translation document mapping product-level OKRs to wave-level milestones and measurable signals (linked).
Runbook contains rollback steps, migration checkpoints, and a KMS/encryption checklist completed for pilot customers.
Dependencies ENG-98021 and ENG-101122 have clear owners and acceptance criteria linked in the ticket.
next_steps: Finalize SE roster and publish on-call schedule by 2026-03-20.
Consolidate Wave A customer list with Sales and Solutions by 2026-03-22.
Complete runbook edits to include hot-fix path and tenant-state rollback by 2026-03-25.
Coordinate a dry-run deployment with Eng on a staging tenant week of 2026-03-29.
Hold pre-pilot readiness review 72 hours before Pilot start.
